summary: The Crypto Company filed a Form 8-K reporting Subscription Agreements dated October 9, 2026 with James Smittkamp and Three Mile Creek Future LLC. The company sold 97,165,533 restricted common shares for $75,000 total consideration — $65,000 cash plus 3.4683 ETH — in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). Chief Strategy Officer Rafael Furst manages the related investor, a related-party element. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing conditions disclosed. This is a dilutive financing, not a special situation; watch related-party pricing and share-count overhang.
